title: Walkthrough Canonical
description: Canonical JSON form of the generator Phase 0.5 walkthrough artifact. Emitted by scripts/generator-pre-run.ts (PF-G5 normalizer) from either .walkthrough.yaml (CLI agents) or .walkthrough.md (Chrome agents). Downstream consumers (PF-G5 gate, auditor spot-check per SP-AAE-04) read only this canonical form. See LR-038 v2 + SP-PWC2-05.

source_tool.description: Which browser tool authored the source artifact. 'cli' = .walkthrough.yaml, 'chrome' = .walkthrough.md.

mcp_session_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the live-DOM session that produced the evidence. Must match the source filename date per LR-013.

fields.description: Optional field inventory — per interactive element surfaced during walkthrough. Absent for spec-fix / non-catalog sessions.

verified_claims.description: Claims the agent verified against live DOM. GEN-029 threshold: minimum 3. Each APP_BUG / PLANNER_GAP status requires a matching 'resolution' field per LR-034 / ALL-043.

resolution.description: Required when status is APP_BUG (match ESC-/BUG-/filed/resolved) or PLANNER_GAP (match ESC-/escalat/corrected).
